purpose: Audit every ratified Investigation-25 export against the one supported Miter runtime. The authority defines the required consumer. Missing present causal use remains mandatory implementation work and never becomes grounds to omit, weaken, or reject the formalization.
constitutive_invariant: Balance unfolding is one movement at contact. Fact9 and the interconnected Flourishings participate inside that movement organization. Relatedness, Appropriateness, and Precision are three heterogeneous simultaneous perspectives in one non-sovereign read event over that same movement, never three objects, stages, judges, votes, or a constructor of movement.

rows.required_runtime_consumer: Every native movement constructor, R/A/P read, effect qualification, consequence transition, and restart validator.
rows.persistent_runtime_consumer: M25ConstitutiveEncounter through CP2M25Encounter, AR2ActiveValid, and AR2MovementConstitutivelyConsistent
rows.positive_difference: A primary movement is formed from the constitutive cut and plural possibilities before R/A/P is read, and the exact formed movement is reconstructed during restore.
rows.material_severance: Disconnecting the one read event or any required perspective invalidates the reading but cannot construct a replacement movement; severing primary material makes restore fail.
rows.neutral_perturbation: Neutral relation ordering preserves the same formed movement.
rows.restoration: Restoring the exact primary organization recovers the same movement without replay.
rows.limit: This proves movement primacy for the finite supported seam, not complete open-ended possibility or every later authority export.

rows.required_runtime_consumer: Movement availability, material discrimination, interface transformation, consequence uptake, and next-cut reorganization as one changing D/Omega/I/W/C relation system.
rows.persistent_runtime_consumer: Stored inside each primary movement and checked during exact reconstitution
rows.positive_difference: D, Omega, I, W, and constitutional relations are retained together with counterfactual-bite witnesses.
rows.material_severance: Removing a required relation changes Relatedness and admissibility.
rows.restoration: Exact restoration recovers the DPF-bearing movement.
rows.limit: The current service does not independently vary all five DPF families across multiple live cuts or prove interface and self-weaving transformation as one higher-order movement.

conclusion: The supported runtime now proves the one-movement/one-RAP-read constitutive correction and four exact M25 meanings. Every other M25 export remains mandatory and is carried forward with its required consumer and missing causal evidence. R3-C2 remains open.
